rows.notes: The cited document is a narrative literature review (Mohd Yussof and Ho 2022, Buildings) of water leak detection methods for smart buildings; it reports no data, experiment, survey or model runs of its own. It summarises hardware (CCTV, GPR, acoustic, fibre optic, IR thermography, RFID) and software (NPW, CFD, fuzzy) methods and machine learning algorithms (SVM, Kalman filter, KNN, ANN, CNN) from other studies, presenting comparison tables of advantages and limitations. It contains no own result on flow metering with predictive analytics/ML preventing water waste or infrastructure damage; the claimed water-conservation effect is only asserted conceptually in the discussion (IoT leak detection in smart buildings) without evidence. Q1 is 'no', so Q2-Q9 are 'no'.
